visual_text: Count the paracetamol in every packet
Usual maximum for most adults: 4 g in 24 hours, about eight 500 mg tablets, across all products.
Some cold and flu remedies contain paracetamol
Under 50 kg or frail? Ask whether a lower maximum suits you
alt_text: Drawn kitchen table where an older Black woman in glasses and cardigan reaches for medicine boxes beside a blister strip and a mug, with numbered markers 1 to 5. Key: co-codamol, co-dydramol, cold and flu remedies, plain paracetamol, and a lower maximum if under 50 kg or frail. Usual maximum 4 g in 24 hours.
